metadata.question: Did the mean tropospheric nitrogen dioxide levels over Shanghai increase between February 10-25, 2020 and April 20-May 12, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: Sentinel-5P TROPOMI NO2 data (tropospheric nitrogen dioxide) - Date 1: February 10-25, 2020 - Date 2: April 20-May 12, 2020 - Location: Shanghai (approximately 31.23°N, 121.47°E) - Use a buffer around Shanghai city center 2. Masking strategy: - Sentinel-5P TROPOMI already provides quality-filtered data - Should filter by QA value to remove poor quality pixels - No cloud masking needed as this is already atmospheric data 3. Logic: - Calculate mean NO2 for each period - Compare: if mean_april > mean_february, then YES (A), else NO (B) - If no valid data exists for either period, output C1 - If after filtering, no valid pixels remain, output C2 - If result is NaN or invalid, output C3 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Shanghai geometry const shanghai = ee.Geometry.Point([121.47, 31.23]).buffer(50000); // 50km buffer // Define time periods const feb_start = '2020-02-10'; const feb_end = '2020-02-25'; const apr_start = '2020-04-20'; const apr_end = '2020-05-12'; // Get Sentinel-5P TROPOMI NO2 data const tropomi = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI_L3_NO2') .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'); // February 2020 collection const feb_col = tropomi .filterDate(feb_start, feb_end) .filterBounds(shanghai); // April-May 2020 collection const apr_col = tropomi .filterDate(apr_start, apr_end) .filterBounds(shanghai); const feb_size = feb_col.size().getInfo(); const apr_size = apr_col.size().getInfo(); print('February 10-25, 2020 images: ' + feb_size); print('April 20-May 12, 2020 images: ' + apr_size); // Check if collections are empty if (feb_size === 0 || apr_size === 0) { print('Missing data for one or both periods.'); print('C1'); return; } // Calculate mean NO2 for February const feb_mean_img = feb_col.mean(); const feb_stats = feb_mean_img.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: shanghai, scale: 5600, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const feb_mean = feb_stats.get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); // Calculate mean NO2 for April-May const apr_mean_img = apr_col.mean(); const apr_stats = apr_mean_img.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: shanghai, scale: 5600, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const apr_mean = apr_stats.get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); // Check for valid results if (feb_mean === null || apr_mean === null || isNaN(feb_mean) || isNaN(apr_mean)) { print('Calculation resulted in null or NaN.'); print('C3'); return; } // Check for pixel counts const feb_count = feb_mean_img.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: shanghai, scale: 5600, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); const apr_count = apr_mean_img.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: shanghai, scale: 5600, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); if (feb_count === 0 || apr_count === 0) { print('No valid pixels after processing.'); print('C2'); return; } print('Feb 10-25 mean NO2: ' + feb_mean.toFixed(4) + ' mol/m²'); print('Apr 20-May 12 mean NO2: ' + apr_mean.toFixed(4) + ' mol/m²'); print('Feb pixels: ' + feb_count + ', Apr pixels: ' + apr_count); // Determine if NO2 increased if (apr_mean > feb_mean) { print('A'); } else { print('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
